slices.name: accounts
slices.summary: Sign-in, two-factor, sessions and account standing (specs/007-configurable-auth-providers, specs/008-seamless-onboarding-flow, specs/017-invite-actor-selection, specs/036-concurrent-client-sessions, specs/039-sharing-attestation, specs/041-two-factor-enrolment)

slices.name: actors
slices.summary: Actors, their ownership and the play field (specs/010-world-staging-actors, specs/017-invite-actor-selection, specs/023-players-section, specs/031-playability, specs/039-sharing-attestation)

neighbours.seam: the stored look of a built hero is what an actor shows
the actor-to-token link is written from the actor side

slices.name: book-import
slices.summary: Importing a source book and reading its PDF (specs/047-the-bestiary, specs/049-importing-a-source-book)

neighbours.seam: an imported book lands in the library's book list

slices.name: canvas
slices.summary: Map authoring on the canvas, drawn walls and board loading (specs/001-bevy-canvas-authoring, specs/002-canvas-authoring-asset-storage, specs/003-dd2vtt-map-fidelity, specs/045-token-movement-and-vision, specs/059-a-map-that-arrives-in-pieces, specs/077-snapping); owns canvas-authoring (measured lane) and token-movement-walls by exact name, since walls are canvas behaviour

neighbours.seam: switching scenes reloads the board the canvas draws

slices.name: collections
slices.summary: Content collections, the account library, sharing and access links (specs/026-content-collections, specs/027-unified-access-links, specs/039-sharing-attestation, specs/040-instance-setup, specs/050-the-account-library)

slices.name: combat
slices.summary: Combat, dice and checks (specs/014-dice-rolling-engine, specs/046-a-fight-that-resolves, specs/056-placing-and-reaching-things-on-a-map)

neighbours.seam: combat writes the hit points that tokens show
combat applies the conditions that status displays show

slices.name: companion
slices.summary: The companion app, chat and session notes (specs/021-unified-markdown-editor, specs/036-concurrent-client-sessions)

neighbours.seam: companion state reaches other clients through the live broadcast

slices.name: compendium
slices.summary: The world compendium and abilities (specs/011-world-compendium, specs/025-world-abilities-compendium, specs/033-abilities-vocabulary, specs/055-a-compendium-you-can-find-things-in)

neighbours.seam: abilities from the compendium are what an attack uses in play

slices.name: engine-limits
slices.summary: Engine frame-rate sweeps and viewport culling, measured-lane specs (specs/029-in-engine-status-displays, specs/046-a-fight-that-resolves)

slices.name: engine-other
slices.summary: The other engine perf and monitor specs, measured lane except engine-monitor (specs/028-client-world-cache, specs/030-interactive-elements, specs/045-token-movement-and-vision); owns the engine- prefix, so a new engine spec lands here unless named elsewhere

slices.name: feedback
slices.summary: In-app feedback (specs/037-in-app-feedback)

slices.name: game-systems
slices.summary: Game-system settings and panel slots (specs/016-system-pack-legal-compliance, specs/032-pack-architecture, specs/033-abilities-vocabulary)

neighbours.seam: each game system supplies the statuses the status display shows

slices.name: genie
slices.summary: The Genie house system (specs/018-genie-house-system, specs/019-genie-leveling-and-trading, specs/020-genie-economy-and-shops)

neighbours.seam: Genie's panels mount in the system panel host

slices.name: hero-builder
slices.summary: Hero builder (specs/044-hero-builder, specs/048-bringing-a-character-in)

neighbours.seam: the builder writes the actor imagery that the art panel shows

slices.name: instance
slices.summary: Instance setup, access, mail and GitHub applications (specs/035-instance-access, specs/040-instance-setup, specs/042-admin-portal); the three instance-setup/instance-first-run-* specs each run in the first-run lane on an unseeded stack of their own, and github-apps in the GitHub-apps lane

slices.name: interactive
slices.summary: Interactive elements: doors, props, regions and secrets (specs/030-interactive-elements, specs/045-token-movement-and-vision); interactive-lighting belongs to lighting by exact name

neighbours.seam: doors are walls that tokens must stop at
opening an element reveals what exploration shows

slices.name: lighting
slices.summary: Light, darkvision and reach of light (specs/030-interactive-elements, specs/045-token-movement-and-vision); owns scene-lighting and interactive-lighting by exact name, over the scene- and interactive- prefixes

neighbours.seam: drawn walls occlude the light this slice casts

slices.name: lore
slices.summary: The lore wiki and its git sync (specs/012-lore-wiki, specs/034-lore-git-sync); lore-repository-sync runs in the GitHub-apps lane

slices.name: moderation
slices.summary: DMCA notices, takedowns and legal enquiries (specs/015-dmca-notice-takedown, specs/052-access-mode-and-legal-duty, specs/053-moderation-across-the-instance)

neighbours.seam: reports and takedowns act on collections

slices.name: play-pause
slices.summary: Pausing and resuming play (specs/051-operator-playfield-shutdown)

neighbours.seam: a lifted pause is caught up through world events
the pause reaches every client through the live broadcast

slices.name: resumable-downloads
slices.summary: Resumable downloads (specs/080-resumable-downloads)

neighbours.seam: the engine loader's progress bar is fed by the downloader's parts
a scene's images are warmed through the downloader

slices.name: rolls
slices.summary: Rolls at the table: every board animates a roll, the chat lists it as each viewer may see it, and the GM reveals hidden ones (specs/081-rolls-at-the-table)

neighbours.seam: the dice roller makes the rolls this slice broadcasts
rolls read in the chat panel's timeline
an attack's rolls are announced as rolls
a check's roll is a roll like any other
the dock sheet's attack buttons are the shared roll buttons
the dock sheet's rolls section, beside a sheet that rolls itself
the sheet page gains a rolls section

slices.name: scenes
slices.summary: Scenes, staging and the player's active scene (specs/009-gm-staging-page, specs/010-world-staging-actors, specs/022-scene-management-overhaul); scene-lighting and scene-preload are owned elsewhere by exact name

neighbours.seam: launching a scene has to respect a paused table

slices.name: status
slices.summary: In-engine status displays (specs/029-in-engine-status-displays)

neighbours.seam: status displays show the hit-point state combat writes

slices.name: tokens
slices.summary: Token authoring, movement and links (specs/004-token-canvas-authoring, specs/006-token-authoring-polish, specs/045-token-movement-and-vision, specs/046-a-fight-that-resolves, specs/056-placing-and-reaching-things-on-a-map); token-movement-walls belongs to canvas by exact name

neighbours.seam: walls stop the tokens this slice moves
tokens are carried across a world session

slices.name: torture
slices.summary: Concurrency torture specs under e2e/torture (specs/036-concurrent-client-sessions)

slices.name: world-cache
slices.summary: The client world cache, prefetch, repair and storage (specs/028-client-world-cache, specs/059-a-map-that-arrives-in-pieces); owns scene-preload by exact name, over the scene- prefix, and the world-cache prefix except the four core specs

slices.name: world-cache-core
slices.summary: The world cache's isolation, offline, peer and multitab behaviour, split from world-cache because world-cache-isolated alone is about six minutes (specs/028-client-world-cache)

slices.name: worlds
slices.summary: Worlds, their dashboard and live sync (specs/005-live-canvas-sync, specs/022-scene-management-overhaul, specs/032-pack-architecture, specs/054-a-dashboard-that-says-whats-going-on)
